basis: Jinshu053:s0058/s0060 and Tongjian083:s0185/s0191 match 黃門令董猛 presenting the prince’s letter and falsifying 長廣公主’s words on Jia’s orders.

Jinshu031:s0582/s0583 explicitly identify 宦人董猛, trusted by the empress and serving the Eastern Palace; s0599 records his execution. Tongjian083:s0274 places 董猛 among those executed at that same collapse.

Jinshu024:s0164 identifies 宦者董猛 appointed 中常侍 by 惠帝 in 元康中. Jinshu053:s0058/s0060 identifies 黃門令董猛 presenting the prince’s letter and acting for Jia in his deposition. The shared full Chinese name, eunuch status, same court and compatible period support a possible identification, but the sealed source does not explicitly connect the appointments or supply a matching event, career callback or family link. Compatible context alone does not establish that the two records are one individual.
